from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        """
        Optimized workflow: SharedMemory deduction then strict Sequential formatting.
        """
        shared = operator.SharedMemory(llm=self.llm, aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_agents=4, num_rounds=2, worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.SM_MINESWEEPER_ROLE_1, prompt_custom.SM_MINESWEEPER_ROLE_2, prompt_custom.SM_MINESWEEPER_ROLE_3, prompt_custom.SM_MINESWEEPER_ROLE_4], aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.SM_MINESWEEPER_AGG)
        draft = await shared(problem)
        seq = operator.Sequential(llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_rounds=1, prompts=[prompt_custom.SEQ_MINESWEEPER_FORMAT])
        solution = await seq(problem + "\n\nShared deductions:\n" + (draft.get("response") or "No deductions recorded."))
        return solution.get('response') or "```python\n\"Unable to determine any mine locations.\"\n```", {
            "worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta() or {},
            "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta() or {},
        }
